item.title: Mino Fall
item.description:
I went to see Mino fall. The way from the station was a good hiking course for me who haven’t had much exercise.

I feel the impact of the monkies was bigger than the fall. The international visitor sat on the bench, he took his eyes off, in the next moment a bag of snack in his tote bag was stolen by monkey!!

I was scary whether I was also stolen my bag.

item.title: About me
item.description:
This is a blog that introduces my recommended spots. Since I live in the Hokusetsu area in Osaka, I mainly introduce around there.

I am studying English, so I try to make time to write a diary in English. Please correct my English, if it’s wrong. Feel free to contact me on Twitter or Contact Form.

  • My name: Misa
  • Occupation: Engineer (Web developer, App developper, Data analyst)
